extraction: Delivery gate rationale detection: uses surface text heuristics to flag rationalization — phrases like 'should work', 'looks correct', 'probably fine', 'seems good' without evidence. Maps to our Engine: cannot finish with 'Santali CER should improve' — must show 'Santali CER 53.91 → 51.2 (measured)'. Verdict: cannot finish with 'fix looks right' — must show 'fix spec: Santali CER < 50, verified by test X'. Miss: cannot finish with 'patch applied' — must show 'CER before/after: 53.91 → 50.8'.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether delivery-gate rationale detection enforces evidence-based finish claims
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
